sources.title: zvoove Acquires Dutch ERP Provider Nocore

items.title: zvoove Clean is assembled from six acquired brands in three years
items.summary: zvoove Clean combines fortytools, CleanManager (Aug 2025), adata (Oct 2025), Nocore (May 2025), KleanApp (Mar 2026) and Leviy; it states 2,500+ customers, 250,000 cleaners and 15+ countries.
items.implication: Integration and shared capabilities (attendance-to-payroll, quality, tenancy) are the main product challenge.

items.title: Planning-to-payroll integration is the stated strategy
items.summary: With adata, zvoove Clean's CEO described 'the first fully integrated cloud platform that covers all processes from workforce planning to payroll', with payroll either in-product or via managed payroll and future accounting outsourcing.
items.implication: Attendance-to-payroll automation and managed payroll are core KPIs for payroll staff and enterprises.

items.title: Large facility companies buy provable quality
items.summary: KleanApp provides digital quality audits, ticketing and NFC/barcode/terminal attendance and is used by 7 of the top 20 German facility companies; zvoove's CEO cites increasing pressure to prove service quality and comply with regulation.
items.implication: Proof-of-presence and standard audits drive enterprise renewals.

items.title: The German cleaning trade is the largest craft by employment
items.summary: Official statistics count 1,005,213 employment relationships in the building-cleaning trade for 2024 (new method counting jobs, not persons); 2023 counted 696,444 persons.
items.implication: A huge, part-time, multi-job workforce makes payroll, minijob rules and attendance proof central.

items.title: SMEs buy all-in-one tools after a free trial
items.summary: fortytools serves 1,200+ customers with quotes, planning, mobile time tracking, invoicing and QM, offers a free 30-day trial and shows a 4.8 rating; comparison articles position it against PlanD and CleanManager.
items.implication: Trial activation (first invoice, staff clocking in) is the SME acquisition lever.

items.title: Multi-country operations tools extend to the Nordics and UK
items.summary: CleanManager serves 425+ customers and 15,000 users in Denmark, Germany and the UK with scheduling, time tracking, quality control and cost calculation.
items.implication: Country packs for tariffs, languages and audit standards are needed beyond DACH.

items.title: Sensor-driven cleaning is emerging in the Netherlands
items.summary: Leviy (150+ companies) integrates dispenser and facility sensors, digital forms, work orders and 24/7 cleaning data for cleaning, holiday parks and healthcare.
items.implication: Demand-driven cleaning changes contracts from frequency to outcome and needs client transparency.

items.title: Dutch market leadership via Nocore
items.summary: zvoove called Nocore the Dutch market leader for cleaning software, making zvoove the European leader in the segment; Nocore also serves staffing agencies specialised in labour migrants.
items.implication: Cleaning and staffing overlap in the Netherlands; bridges to staffing products matter.

items.title: Many cleaning firms combine several point tools
items.summary: A 2026 German comparison notes that successful cleaning firms typically combine two or three specialised tools (e.g. time tracking plus invoicing) rather than one all-in-one solution.
items.implication: Open APIs and DATEV export matter even for all-in-one products; substitutes like frontline apps compete for the cleaner app slot.
